tagsTab.heading: Tags
tagsTab.appliesToDesc: Object types this tag may attach to
tagsTab.paramPolicyDesc: Whether an assignment names a value, as in entity:customer
tagsTab.noValues: No values yet — an assignment cannot be made until one is added
tagsTab.deleteConfirm: Delete tag "{{id}}"? Its assignments are removed as well.
tagsTab.derivedTagHelp: Derived from each object's own registration — never assigned
tagsTab.purposeBody: A tag is one org-wide label with fixed meaning, applied to sources, tables, columns, relationships, or commands. Tags carry behavior, not just documentation: technical keeps a column out of the Data Product export, entity turns a column's values into retrieval vocabulary, deprecated tells consumers to migrate off.
tagsTab.purposeAdd: The registry is single. A tag that applies to several object types is one identity everywhere, so editing it in any of the scoped lists edits it in all of them.
